Parent — I manage my child\'s device
To keep your child safe, Haris monitors this device. Please review what is collected before you continue. Set up by a parent or guardian.

Web addresses are filtered to block inappropriate sites. A local VPN does this on-device.
Analysis happens on this device. Flagged events and alerts are sent to the parent\'s Haris account so you can review them. Your child is shown a notice that monitoring is active.
I am this child\'s parent or guardian, and I consent to Haris monitoring this device as described above.
To protect your child, Haris needs the following permissions. These permissions allow us to monitor activity and enforce screen time limits.
Required for monitoring text content across apps to detect inappropriate messages, cyberbullying, and potential predatory behavior.
Required for tracking screen time and app usage to enforce daily limits and bedtime restrictions.
Required for displaying the lock screen when screen time limits are exceeded or during bedtime hours.
Required to prevent Android from killing Haris in the background. Without this, text monitoring may stop working unexpectedly.
Required for content filtering to block inappropriate websites. Haris uses a local VPN to filter web content - no data is sent to external servers.
Required to allow phone calls during bedtime and screen time limits. Your child will always be able to make and receive emergency calls.
Required for sexting prevention. Haris needs full storage access to detect and blur inappropriate images, protecting your child from harmful content.
Required for sexting prevention. Enable \'All files access\' to allow Haris to detect and blur inappropriate images, protecting your child from harmful content.
Required for showing alerts and notifications about your child\'s device activity.
Some features may not work without all permissions
